comparison_model: IF ship_ice_strengthened = true AND construction_date >= '2026-01-01', THEN independent_echo_sounding_device_count >= 2 OR (echo_sounding_device_count >= 1 AND independent_transducer_count >= 2) OR administration_approved_equivalent_depth_sounding_device_present = true.
source_basis: Polar Code 2026 supplement 9-1.3.2.1.1: ice-strengthened ships constructed on/after 1 Jan 2026 need two independent echo sounders OR one echo sounder with two independent transducers OR an Administration-accepted equivalent.

cases.rationale: Applicable ship satisfies route 1 exactly at two independent echo-sounding devices.
cases.oracle: If ice-strengthened and date>=2026-01-01, at least one of the three regulatory routes must be satisfied.

cases.rationale: Applicable ship satisfies route 2: one echo-sounding device with two independent transducers.
